1. basic true/false t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n %}translated{% fallback %}fallback{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "translated", t.render(use_i18n=True) assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "fallback", t.render(use_i18n=False) print("1. basic true/false OK") # 2. translation actually happens (de locale) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans true %}watch out{% fallback %}fallback{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(LANGUAGE="de") == "pass auf", t.render(LANGUAGE="de") assert t.render(LANGUAGE="en") == "watch out" print("2. translation OK") # 3. fallback is NOT translated t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans false %}watch out{% fallback %}watch out{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(LANGUAGE="de") == "watch out" print("3. fallback untranslated OK") # 4. variables: implicit (referenced in content) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n %}Hello {{ name }}{% fallback %}Bye {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, name="World") == "Hello World" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, name="World") == "Bye World" assert t.render(use_i18n=True, name="World", LANGUAGE="de") == "Hallo World" print("4. implicit vars OK") # 5. variables: explicit assignment + comma separators t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, name='X' %}Hello {{ name }}{% fallback %}Bye {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "Hello X" assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "Bye X" print("5. explicit vars w/ comma OK") # 5b. variables without commas t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n name='X' %}Hello {{ name }}{% fallback %}Bye {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "Hello X" assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "Bye X" print("5b. explicit vars no comma OK") # 5c. mixed separators t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, a='1' b='2' %}{{ a }}-{{ b }}{% fallback %}f{{ a }}f{{ b }}{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "1-2" assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "f1f2" print("5c. mixed separators OK") # 6. plural t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, count %}{{ count }} item{% pluralize %}" "{{ count }} items{% fallback %}{{ count }} object{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=1) == "1 item" assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=3) == "3 items" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, count=3) == "3 object" # de locale plurals t2 = env.from_string( '{% ctrans true, count %}%(count)s item{% pluralize %}' '%(count)s items{% fallback %}{{ count }} object{% endctrans %}' ) assert t2.render(count=1, LANGUAGE="de") == "1 Element" assert t2.render(count=3, LANGUAGE="de") == "3 Elemente" print("6. plural OK") # 7. pluralize with explicit variable t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, count %}{{ count }} item{% pluralize count %}" "{{ count }} items{% fallback %}{{ count }} object{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=1) == "1 item" assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=3) == "3 items" print("7. pluralize explicit var OK") # 8. trimmed applies to all blocks incl fallback t = env.from_string( "{%- ctrans use_i18n trimmed %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb\n fb {% endctrans -%}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "hello world", repr(t.render(use_i18n=True)) assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "fb fb", repr(t.render(use_i18n=False)) print("8. trimmed all blocks OK") # 9. notrimmed override of policy env_trim = make_env() env_trim.policies["ext.i18n.trimmed"] = True t = env_trim.from_string( "{%- ctrans use_i18n %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb\n fb {% endctrans -%}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "hello world" assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "fb fb" t = env_trim.from_string( "{%- ctrans use_i18n notrimmed %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb\n fb {% endctrans -%}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == " hello\n world " assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == " fb\n fb " print("9. trimmed policy + notrimmed OK") # 10. missing fallback -> TemplateSyntaxError with message for src in ( "{% ctrans true %}x{% endctrans %}", "{% ctrans true %}x{% pluralize %}y{% endctrans %}", ): with pytest.raises(TemplateSyntaxError) as ei: env.from_string(src) assert "expected 'fallback' block" in str(ei.value), str(ei.value) print("10. missing fallback errors OK") # 11. unclosed block -> TemplateSyntaxError for src in ( "{% ctrans true %}x{% fallback %}y", "{% ctrans true %}x{% pluralize %}y{% fallback %}z", "{% ctrans true %}x", ): with pytest.raises(TemplateSyntaxError) as ei: env.from_string(src) assert "unclosed conditional translation block" in str(ei.value), str(ei.value) print("11. unclosed block errors OK") # 12. duplicate variables -> TemplateAssertionError with 'defined twice' with pytest.raises(TemplateAssertionError) as ei: env.from_string( "{% ctrans true, a, a %}x{% fallback %}y{% endctrans %}" ) assert "defined twice" in str(ei.value), str(ei.value) with pytest.raises(TemplateAssertionError) as ei: env.from_string( "{% ctrans true a=1 a=2 %}x{% fallback %}y{% endctrans %}" ) assert "defined twice" in str(ei.value) print("12. duplicate variable errors OK") # 13. newstyle env_new = make_env(newstyle=True) t = env_new.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, count %}%(count)s item{% pluralize %}" "%(count)s items{% fallback %}{{ count }} object{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=1, LANGUAGE="de") == "1 Element" assert t.render(use_i18n=True, count=3, LANGUAGE="de") == "3 Elemente" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, count=3) == "3 object" t = env_new.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, name %}Hello %(name)s{% fallback %}Bye %(name)s{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, name="World", LANGUAGE="de") == "Hallo World" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, name="World") == "Bye World" print("13. newstyle OK") # 14. condition with complex expression t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans level >= 2 and show %}pro{% fallback %}free{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(level=3, show=True) == "pro" assert t.render(level=1, show=True) == "free" assert t.render(level=3, show=False) == "free" print("14. complex condition OK") # 15. integration with i18n extension env_both = Environment( extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n", ConditionalI18nExtension] ) env_both.install_gettext_callables(gettext, ngettext) t = env_both.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n %}watch out{% fallback %}fallback{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, LANGUAGE="de") == "pass auf" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, LANGUAGE="de") == "fallback" print("15. i18n integration OK") # 16. autoescape behavior env_esc = Environment(autoescape=True, extensions=[ConditionalI18nExtension]) env_esc.globals.update(gettext=gettext, ngettext=ngettext) t = env_esc.from_string( '{% ctrans use_i18n %}t{% fallback %}f{% endctrans %}' ) out_true = t.render(use_i18n=True) out_false = t.render(use_i18n=False) print("16. autoescape outputs:", repr(out_true), repr(out_false)) assert out_true == out_false, (out_true, out_false) # 17. percent signs preserved t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n %}100%% sure{% fallback %}99%% sure{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True) == "100% sure", repr(t.render(use_i18n=True)) assert t.render(use_i18n=False) == "99% sure", repr(t.render(use_i18n=False)) print("17. percent signs OK") # 18. fallback with variables and literal percent t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, x %}{{ x }} is 100%%{% fallback %}{{ x }} is 50%%{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=True, x="a") == "a is 100%" assert t.render(use_i18n=False, x="a") == "a is 50%" print("18. percent + vars OK") # 19. fallback-only variables (not in translatable block) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n %}static{% fallback %}Fb {{ only_f }}{% endctrans %}" ) assert t.render(use_i18n=False, only_f="v") == "Fb v" assert t.render(use_i18n=True, only_f="v") == "static" print("19. fallback-only vars OK") # 20. unknown variable for pluralization with pytest.raises(TemplateAssertionError): env.from_string( "{% ctrans true %}{{ a }} x{% pluralize b %}y{% fallback %}z{% endctrans %}" ) print("20. unknown plural var OK") print("\nALL MANUAL TESTS PASSED")

orig_parse_expr = P.Parser.parse_expression
def traced(self):
    print('parse_expression start, current:', self.stream.current.type, self.stream.current.value)
    rv = orig_parse_expr(self)
    print('parse_expression end, current:', self.stream.current.type, self.stream.current.value)
    return rv

    print('--- parse done, current:', parser.stream.current.type, parser.stream.current.value)
    return rv
